intro: The Deathstalkers' Report is a crucial military courier assignment delivered to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher. After securing injured Deathstalkers in the northern wilds, you carry their gathered intelligence concerning unexpected Scourge activity back to Forsaken high command. This dispatch alters the Forsaken's assessment of their hold on Silverpine Forest.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Although Quinn's wounds are mending, I want to get our report to High Executor Hadrec as quickly as possible. It has information that is vital to the Forsaken's occupation of Silverpine.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did you discover the fate of the Deathstalkers?

clips.title: Completion
paras: I hadn't accounted for the level of Scourge presence we've seen in Silverpine Forest, nor for the troubles our Deathstalkers have had in their scouting efforts.
Your aid to our Deathstalkers was invaluable, friend. And you will be commended.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
